ways.label: Track from Hakatere Potts Road to Mt Potts Conservation Area boundary

start.name: Hakatere Potts Road
start.quote: The track starts on Hakatere Potts Road

end.name: Mt Potts Conservation Area boundary
end.quote: The track ends at the boundary of Mt Potts Conservation Area.

evidence: The track starts on Hakatere Potts Road, then climbs steadily up the hill.
The track ends at the boundary of Mt Potts Conservation Area.
There is no DOC-maintained track beyond this point.

doubts: Shape is one_way from DOC's '30 min one way' and the track ending at the conservation area boundary; the text does not say how walkers come back (presumably the same way). No feature or name marks the boundary, so the end has no ref. Erewhon Hut is a private hut somewhere within the conservation area, not on this track.
